description: The 15 multilingual replication stems, TITLE ONLY. A title is a handful of topical words, so a bare stem in one is a real signal, while the same stem anywhere in a 1,500-character abstract is noise — the distinction keyword_verdict() draws by taking title and abstract separately. The non-English stems reach works the English ones cannot (111 of 112 Korean 재검증 works are invisible to the English stems); they carry no matching phrases, so the cheap tier is the right destination.
